articles.title: A New Quantum Idea Starts With Very Unusual Helium
articles.summary: What if a different liquid helped protect quantum information? Surrey researchers predict that a superfluid-helium qubit could make around 100 times fewer errors, but they still need to test a prototype.

articles.title: Snow Is a Glacier’s Shield—and Its Building Material
articles.summary: Winter snow does two jobs for a glacier. Swiss scientists report that glaciers lost 5.5 percent of their ice volume this year after heat waves and low snowfall.

articles.title: A Protein Label Does Not Tell the Whole Food Story
articles.summary: Protein does much more than build muscles. Smithsonian asked experts why adding it to a cookie does not automatically make the cookie healthier.
